summary: Verified bookmarklet autofill bug fix end-to-end. Created a customer order with all required fields (Purchased By, Description, Consideration, First/Second Party, Stamp Duty, Paid By), logged in as admin, extracted the javascript: href from BookmarkletLink, decoded it, and executed it on /shcil-mock.html via page.evaluate. All 7 target SHCIL fields were populated correctly (including the 3 priority fields and the Paid By select dropdown).
critical_code_review_comments: bookmarklet.js correctly uses React-safe native value setter via Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor on HTMLInputElement/HTMLTextAreaElement prototype and dispatches input/change/blur events — good.
Label resolution walks previousSibling text nodes, closest's previousElementSibling, and row.cells[0] which matches SHCIL's Label table layout — verified against mock harness.
Synonyms include SHCIL-specific labels (Stamp Duty Purchased by, Description of Document, Consideration of Property) — matched successfully.
Longest-match tie-breaking ensures 'first party' doesn't accidentally win over 'name and address of the first party' — verified.
Minor: bookmarklet uses alert() which blocks on real sites; acceptable for user-triggered bookmarklet but Playwright must register page.on('dialog').

seed_data_creation: Created one submitted customer order (id 681f1fbd-...) with Purchased By=Ramesh Patel, Description=Lease agreement for shop premises, Consideration=500000, First Party=A Kumar, Second Party=B Shah, Stamp Duty=29400, Paid By=First Party.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bookmarklet verification flow: (1) create submitted order via customer flow at /login, (2) admin login at /admin/login, (3) click data-testid=view-order-<id> to open dialog, (4) read href from data-testid=bookmarklet-link-<id>, (5) goto /shcil-mock.html, (6) register page.on('dialog', d=>d.accept()), (7) page.evaluate(decodeURIComponent(href.slice(11))). All 7 mock inputs populated: #ctl00_cph_txtPurBy, #ctl00_cph_txtDesc, #ctl00_cph_txtConsidr, #ctl00_cph_txtFp, #ctl00_cph_txtSp, #ctl00_cph_txtDuty, #ctl00_cph_ddlPaidBy.
rca of the issue: Original bug: 0 fields filled on shcilestamp.com. Root cause: SHCIL uses table layout with sibling <td> labels (no <label> elements) and cryptic name/id. Previous bookmarklet only matched on name/id/label[for] — none worked. Fix (verified): bookmarklet.js now reads context from previous <td> siblings, row.cells[0], and ancestor text; uses longest-matching synonym; uses React-safe native value setter + input/change/blur events. All 3 priority fields and 4 additional fields fill correctly on the faithful mock harness.
